shared_facts.value: Chat interaction configuration includes goal/style, response length, and custom prompts, all of which are notebook-scoped settings [1].
shared_facts.note: Repo-backed clarification: src/notebooklm/cli/chat.py accepts custom instructions as raw string input via --custom-instructions/--persona and does not define an extra CLI-enforced character limit beyond style validation.

shared_facts.value: Saving chat history or specific responses must result in the creation of a real notebook note via the notes.create SDK method, rather than a text-based source [1-4].
Valid values for chat goal/style are 'default', 'learning-guide', and 'custom' [4].
Valid values for response length are 'default', 'longer', and 'shorter' [4].
Note export and note-to-source conversion are explicitly out of scope for this screen [3, 5].

fe_facts.value: The 'notebooklm configure' command performs a partial patch update when only one configuration axis (e.g., length) is changed [4].
The 'notebooklm configure' command performs an absolute set when both goal/style and length are specified simultaneously [4].
The 'notebooklm history --save' CLI command creates a real notebook note from the current chat history, defaulting the note title to 'Chat History' when none is supplied [4].
fe_facts.note: Confirmed in src/notebooklm/cli/chat.py where history --save uses client.notes.create(..., title or "Chat History", ...).

fe_facts.value: The 'notebooklm ask --save-as-note' CLI command allows saving a specific chat response as a real note, defaulting the title to `Chat: {question[:50]}` when none is supplied [1].
fe_facts.note: Confirmed in src/notebooklm/cli/chat.py where ask --save-as-note calls client.notes.create() with title or f"Chat: {question[:50]}".

fe_facts.value: The 'notebooklm configure' command manages the display and reset flows for chat configuration [1].
fe_facts.note: Workflow helpers that synthesize text sources are out of scope for this screen and do not redefine note semantics here.

be_facts.value: src/notebooklm/_chat.py exposes get_settings(), set_settings(), update_settings(), and reset_settings() as the core SDK interface [1].
The backend implementation for saving chat artifacts must use client.notes.create() to ensure real note creation [1, 4].
src/notebooklm_mcp/tools/chat_settings.py provides the current MCP parity for fetching, patching, and resetting these settings [1].

notes: Facts are derived from explicit parity matrices and resolved BA decisions.
Scope is tightly maintained to chat configuration and note-saving behavior as requested.
The distinction between global settings (language) and notebook settings (chat) is preserved.

The readiness blockers are resolved by the current repo contract: reset is the only revert mechanism, custom instructions have no extra CLI-enforced length rule, and note-saving defaults are explicit in src/notebooklm/cli/chat.py.
